title: Belt cleanup
description: An Old Works Scuttler is shadowing the ore haulers out of the Starogród belt. Cull it, dock at Jernborg, and the bounty office settles the fee.

title: Supply run to Przystań
description: Przystań is short on ion rounds. Buy 200 rounds (1 m³) on the Jernborg market and carry them to the Przystań hangar — one gate jump into the Fringe. The cargo is the delivery: do not spend it on the way.

title: Kerngrit order
description: Jernborg's refinery needs 400 m³ of raw Kerngrit. Fill the ore hold at the Starogród belt and dock to turn the order in.
